subject: Supplier onboarding: StelloAI - vendor setup

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier onboarding: StelloAI - vendor setup

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for inference capacity. Procurement side here — I wanted to kick off vendor setup so we can get POs flowing as soon as the pilot signs off. To move forward we typically need the following items from vendors: 

- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached as vendor_onboarding_form.docx)
- Tax documentation: W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (non-US), and VAT registration certificate if applicable
- Bank details (Wires/EFT) and remittance email for AP
- Primary billing contact and remit-to address

If you can send those over I’ll open the vendor record in NetSuite and follow up with standard PO terms (we default to net30 unless otherwise negotiated). Target timeline: vendor created within 2 business days after we receive forms.

Quick ask: can you confirm whether StelloAI is a US entity (W-9) or non-US (W-8BEN-E) and attach whichever tax doc is appropriate? Also please attach bank details for EFT.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Finance to speed verification.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.docx (Microsoft Word)
